kernelIrBoundaries.evidence: Command is represented by BattleSubject plus BattleCommandOptionChoiceHole/BattleFill commandOptionChoice; the boundary enters reducer execution through supported procedure profiles and typed fills.
kernelIrBoundaries.summary: Executable reducer commands are selected Battle subjects and command-option choices, not authored spell names.

kernelIrBoundaries.evidence: BattleHole and BattleFill are already parsed by the frontier checker; future IR should reuse the hole/fill split instead of embedding table facts in command state.
kernelIrBoundaries.summary: Caller, table, roll, choice, and result facts enter through typed hole/fill frontiers.

kernelIrBoundaries.evidence: BattleResolutionResult, CreationBatchFillResult, CreationFinalizationResult, and sheet result unions are the existing effect-facing result boundary; ordinary invalid input stays typed rather than thrown.
kernelIrBoundaries.summary: Reducer results distinguish resolved state, requested holes, and typed invalid outcomes.

kernelIrBoundaries.evidence: BattleState, CharacterDraft/CharacterBuild, CharacterSheet, and battle initialization inputs are distinct state owners; future IR should project between them rather than duplicate durable facts.
kernelIrBoundaries.summary: Mutable reducer state remains runtime-owned and is projected from shared algebras, Surface records, and character-sheet facts.

kernelIrBoundaries.evidence: BattleActiveEffect and BattleActiveEffectExpiration already isolate ongoing reducer state from authored identity; lifecycle reducers own turn, duration, concentration, and cleanup transitions.
kernelIrBoundaries.summary: Battle active effects are typed occurrence state with expiration and cleanup semantics.

kernelIrBoundaries.evidence: BattleUnitSupportProfile, SupportedSpellInvocation, CharacterCreationSupportProfile, and battle support-profile projection are admission boundaries; generator IR should consume profile facts, not authored catalog identity.
kernelIrBoundaries.summary: Support profiles admit Surface records into executable procedure shapes before reducer execution.

kernelIrBoundaries.evidence: BattleTurnResources, CharacterBattleResourceState, spell-cast spend helpers, CharacterSheetResourceState, and handoff expenditure projection already separate transient battle availability from durable sheet expenditure.
kernelIrBoundaries.summary: Resources are split by owner: turn economy in battle, spell/feature expenditure on sheet state, and battle-local resource snapshots during combat.

kernelIrBoundaries.evidence: characterSheetBattleInit, battleCreatureInitFromCharacterBuild, and applyBattleHandoffToCharacterSheet own deterministic cross-runtime projection, conflict rejection, and durable state settlement.
kernelIrBoundaries.summary: Character-battle handoff projects state into battle and settles accepted battle-owned changes back to character sheet state.
